Poultry and Livestock Insurance

In agriculture, your animals are more than just assets—they’re the heart of your business. But disease outbreaks, natural disasters, and theft can strike without warning, leading to devastating financial losses.

This is why Poultry and Livestock Insurance matters.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Poultry and Livestock Insurance that covers the following:
• Animal diseases (infectious, invasive and non-contagious)
• Standard perils (such as natural disasters or theft)
• Business interruption (caused by death or loss of insured livestock)
• Carriage/transportation of poultry and livestock including sea, air or railway transport
• Note: Other inclusions as may be arranged

What is the information needed for Poultry and Livestock Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Location of Poultry/Livestock to be insured
• Valuation of Poultry/Livestock
• Loss history
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
